    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AuthController
    REST endpoints for user registration and login.
    AuthResponse
    Response returned after a successful login, identifying the new session.
    AuthService
    Handles user registration and login, including account lockout after repeated failed login attempts.
    ConflictException
    Registration rejected because the username or email is already taken.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Translates auth-related exceptions and validation errors into HTTP error responses.
    LoginRequest
    Credentials submitted when logging in.
    Main
     
    RegisterRequest
    Details submitted when registering a new account.
    RegisterResponse
    Public profile returned after successful registration.
    SecurityConfig
    Security-related bean configuration.
    SessionRepository
    Repository for accessing session records.
    UnauthorizedException
    Login rejected: unknown user, bad password, locked, or inactive account.
    User
    User entity representing a user in the system.
    UserRepository
    Repository interface for accessing User entities.
    UserSession
    Session entity representing an authenticated user's active login session.
